subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR keep the unintegrated multi-pass compaction engine and new public marker surface, or should it be narrowed to the production pre-pruning/summary behavior until callers are ready?
rationale: The branch contains useful compaction ideas, but the current production value is pre-pruning and summary disambiguation while the multi-pass loop remains unwired and the public API addition needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Drop or keep private the unwired multi-pass/public marker surface, fix preserved-turn pruning, and land only the production behavior with real proof.

options.title: Sponsor full integration
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the new architecture and require the PR to wire multi-pass compaction into real callers before merge.

options.title: Pause for canonical design
options.body: Defer or close this branch in favor of the broader compaction architecture discussion if the current scope is too speculative.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Drop or keep private the unwired multi-pass/public marker surface, fix preserved-turn pruning, and land only the production behavior with real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the live PR assignee and the visible maintainer-side owner for deciding whether to narrow or sponsor the feature direction.
